what: a variable round from r1 to r5 along a box's top back edge: the balls' envelope, a circular cone, not their great circles
method: box 20x30x20, the top back edge (y = 30, z = 20) with r = 1 + x/5 from x = 0 to 20. The balls' centres (x, 30 - r, 20 - r) run on a line, r proportional to their distance from the apex (-5, 30, 20): their envelope is the circular cone about that line with sin(phi) = 1/sqrt(27). Each ball touches it along the circle square to the line of centres, offset -r r'/|c'| from the centre, not along the great circle (whose middle is 0.0101 off the cone at x = 10). In each plane x = const the cone's section cuts off the corner, between the contact lines, the area found by rays from the corner (each meets the cone at the root of a quadratic); integrated over x it is 43.777573: V = 12000 - 43.777573 = 11956.2224. Faces 7; both seams G1, not G2.
